text:
maria.g: Quick weekly rollup — running a docs sweep. Small asks: 1) owners confirm any pages requiring urgent fixes before EOD Fri, 2) flag any embargoed content, 3) PRs that need a final review. Posting current quick list below. :wave:

leo: FYI one of the runtime guides has a 404 on the diagram image (runtime/kv-cache.png). I can rehost if nobody claims the page.

devon: I can claim runtime/kv-cache.md for this week. Will open a tiny PR to swap the image URL to the rehosted asset.

ash: Heads-up — onboarding/curl-snippets has a stale example (uses v1 API key param). PR #4857 fixes the snippet, but needs a reviewer. cc @devon @maria.g :eyes:

maria.g: Thanks — @devon please review #4857 when you have a window. If you don't get to it today, I'll queue it for editorial.

leo: For runtime/kv-cache I opened a draft PR with the rehosted image and a brief alt text tweak: #4862. Small sed one-liner in the PR description to fix the path.

devon: Reviewing #4857 now. Quick note on the curl change — can we also add a note about the updated rate limit headers? One-liner in the same PR would be ideal.

ash: Good call. I'll add the note and push an amendment.

docs-bot: Reminder — docs:owner-scan completed. Found 12 pages with broken internal links this week. List: runtime/kv-cache.md, onboarding/curl-snippets.md, kb/orphan-diagram.md, ... (full scan in /mnt/docs-scans/weekly-1764.json) :mag: 

maria.g: Can owners claim any of the 12? If not, please reply with "dibs" and an ETA. We'll do a small batch tomorrow at 10am PT.

ash: dibs onboarding/curl-snippets.md — ETA: today EOD.

leo: dibs runtime/kv-cache.md — ETA: tomorrow noon PT.

devon: I can take kb/orphan-diagram.md — ETA: tomorrow afternoon.

maria.g: Awesome — adding to the 10am PT sweep. For the PR queue: #4857 (ash) and #4862 (leo) are the highest priority. @devon will review #4857 now; @maria.g will do a final pass after the change.

ash: quick heads-up — minor frontmatter oddity on handbook/alerts.md (missing canonical). I'll push a 1-line fix in the same PR as the curl snippet so we don't churn separate reviews.

devon: SG. If anyone runs into a CODEOWNERS block, drop the path here and I can temporarily add myself to the review to unblock.

maria.g: Thanks team. If no other urgent flags, I'll post the sweep agenda to calendar and add the Zoom link. Ping here if you need to reschedule. :zap:

leo: one tiny follow-up — are we ok with rehosting runtime diagrams on the S3 bucket under /docs-media/2024? saves us from the third-party CDN rot.

maria.g: Yes, approved. Use the docs-media bucket, set public-read, and add original source URL in the PR description.

devon: noted. Also, tagging infra to rotate the bucket policy next week.

ash: all set from me. Going to finish #4857 edits and mark it ready for review.

maria.g: Closing the loop — thanks everyone. I'll update the weekly sweep doc with claims and PRs. If anything pops, reply in-thread. :white_check_mark:
